description: US.CommonUtilityNetwork.Telecommunications is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by trafikverket.se. The data set records fibre optic cables intended exclusively for the operation of rail and road. The data set includes the total fibre network managed by the Swedish Transport Administration. Coverage: SE. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
